description: The database knowledge layer: cloud database CATEGORIES with when-to-use guidance and each cloud's equivalent product. Use this to pick the right kind of database for a scenario, then map it across clouds. Categories: relational (RDS), cloud-native relational (Aurora-class), cache (Redis), document (MongoDB), key-value/wide-column (DynamoDB-class), data warehouse/columnar (OLAP), specialized (time-series/graph). Each has positioning, use_cases, not_for, cross-cloud products, pricing_model (instance vs capacity), and comparable (whether prices can be compared cross-cloud — instance-based yes, capacity-based no). Pass a category id to get just one. Pricing per product is a separate (upcoming) tool.

category.description: optional category id to fetch just one: relational, relational_cloudnative, cache, document, keyvalue_widecolumn, olap, specialized
